subject: delta(client): WF record a suspension when a stopped host refuses a session renewal
note: sessionRenewal and sessionRenewalAccept authenticate their request with the purchase's handoff token but were missing from the service's list of token actions, so a stopped host refused them writes_stopped without suspending the purchase's queued work, and verifyDeal continued that work once the stop was lifted. Both are now token actions: a stopped host refusing either suspends the queued work of the purchase the token authenticates, as agreementSubmit does, and only protocolRecheck naming the suspension continues it.
